nora: quick flagging - onboarding run for atlas-13B (int8) with 16k prefill hit sporadic kv_index reorders around ~8100 and small generation glitches. attaching minimal repro notes.

ema_ml: can you paste the exact invocation + envs?

nora: ran: `./prefill_runner --model atlas-13b --quant int8 --ctx 16384 --prefill tests/seed_16k.txt --shards 4` with ENV ROPE_SCALE=1.0 but i noticed runtime nodes had ROPE_SCALE=0.9 set by a bad pool env.

jin: that mismatch will shift rotary coordinates and can change key hashing -> index collisions/wrap. did you also compare fp32 baseline?\n
nora: fp32 baseline clean. int4/int8 both show more noise; int8 reproduction consistent when runtime rope differs.

carla: additionally saw compaction activity during the run - compaction kickoff around slot 8096. could be a concurrency window where compaction reorders index entries.

devops-bot: CI job 101234 queued: atlas-longprefill-smoke (see http://ci.internal/101234) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ema_ml: action items: 1) add fast startup assertion comparing compiled_rope_hash vs runtime_rope_hash and exit with clear error if mismatch; 2) add sampled telemetry when kv_index reorders are detected (shard, slot-range, quant-mode, rope metadata) for in-prod detection; 3) deterministic unit test that forces compaction at shard boundary to reproduce reorder.

jin: for the indexing fix, prefer deriving kv keys from stable integers (pos + head id) before any rotary transform so rope scaling doesn't affect index key inputs. this separates coordinate frame from the index.

nora: i'll implement the telemetry + reproduce harness (small deterministic token stream that crosses shard/compaction threshold).

carla: i'll do the runtime assertion patch and update docs with a troubleshooting blurb. make the error actionable (how to reconcile compiled vs runtime rope config).

ema_ml: i'll schedule a nightly bisect across quant codepaths (fp32,int8,int4) toggling compaction strategies and rope_scale variants; store failing seeds in the regression corpus.

devops-bot: scheduled nightly job: quant-kv-bisect starting 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC (job id 101235).

jin: also add a tiny fuzz harness that applies micro perturbations to pre-hash inputs to validate ordering invariance across quantization. helps catch subtle hash sensitivity.

nora: pushed small test harness and a failing CI run recorded: http://ci.internal/101236. leaving thread until PRs merged and nightly bisect completes. :white_check_mark:
